name: Love Pledge Chi no Meiyaku
source:
An Omerta is a blood promise; a ceremony of a ghost and a living person, promising to love one another forever. A couple bound by this blood promise is said to have eternal love that lasts even through different lives and reincarnations…

While living in a seaside town, you meet a man during a commute.
The Omerta slowly leads him into battles. He fights to protect you. He fights for himself. Your love with him evolves into…
